name: CoA display patch stream leaves the client's own textured displays alone (#6729, #6899, #6985, #7099)
contract: Requires CoA.SendDisplayPatches=1 and no DataDir/dbc_clientset copy, the default setup.
SMSG_PATCH_CREATURE_DISPLAY_INFO (0x0976) rows carry no texture names, so a row that replaces one the client
already has draws the model untextured (paper white). Without the client copy the server sent every display id
at or above 652000, all of which the client already holds, blanking 323 textured mounts, pets and summons. The
server's DataDir/dbc is the client's own table, so it now decides which rows the client lacks. Expected after
the 5 s login fallback: the Gold Slyvern 945298, Build: Mechsuit 916645, Yellow Skitterfly 945352, Hammy 945545
and Undying Darkhound (Viridescent) 945523 rows are not sent, while the creaturedisplayinfo_dbc-only row 652000
the client lacks is still sent. Socketless packet construction does not establish client rendering.
